name: Asyntai AI Chatbot
description: Ask a question in Mattermost and get an answer built from your own content. Works as a slash command or by messaging the bot directly.

settings_schema.header: Answers questions from your own content. You need an Asyntai account with a paid plan, because the assistant is reached over the Asyntai API. Get the API key at https://asyntai.com under Settings, API.
settings_schema.footer: Ask a question with /asyntai <question>, or send a direct message to the Asyntai bot.

settings.help_text: From your Asyntai account, under Settings, API. The plugin does nothing until this is filled in.
Leave empty to use your primary website in Asyntai. Set a numeric ID to ask a different one.

settings.display_name: Answer direct messages to the bot
settings.help_text: When on, a user can hold a normal conversation with the Asyntai bot in a direct message.
Leave empty to use https://asyntai.com. Only change this if Asyntai support asks you to.
